text:
maria_docs: Quick sync — adding a short note for Nordics availability and data locality. Want to include a tiny CLI + JS SDK example showing the region header and a one-line legal caveat. Could someone pair on wording?

juan_l10n: I can do the snippet. Quick Q: do we prefer `X-Redwood-Region: nordics` or `Region: nordics`?

sam_platform: use `X-Region` for now — it's what the router reads in Dedicated/Private. Full header: `X-Region: nordics` (we normalize to lowercase).

juan_l10n: Cool. Draft snippet below — please sanity check before I push to the PR.

juan_l10n: ```bash
# CLI example
curl -sS https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \n  -H "X-Region: nordics" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-1-small","prompt":"Hello from Nordics"}'
```

juan_l10n: ```js
// Node SDK example
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY });
const res = await client.generate({
  model: 'redwood-1-small',
  prompt: 'Hello from Nordics',
  headers: { 'X-Region': 'nordics' }
});
console.log(res.text);
```

emma_legal: Suggestion on legal blurb: "Requests routed to the Nordics region are processed within EU/EEA boundaries where possible; customers should consult their contract for residency guarantees." Keep it short and non-binding.

maria_docs: That phrasing is good. Can we add one sentence about exceptions (fallbacks to other EU regions if capacity constrained)?

emma_legal: Yes — add: "If local capacity is unavailable, requests may be routed to compatible EU regions; we surface this in the console and logs."

sam_platform: FYI: router will surface `x-region-fallback` header when fallback happens. Maybe show how to detect it in the snippet?

juan_l10n: Added tiny note below the snippets showing detection: `if (res.headers['x-region-fallback']) { /* handle */ }`

juan_l10n: Pushed a small branch and opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234 — includes the CLI, SDK snippet, and the two-line legal note.

docs-bot: build status — docs CI: success ✅ (netlify-preview/preview #1234)

maria_docs: Nice, can someone do a quick copy edit for style and then i'll merge? Mainly tense and British vs US English (we use US).

sam_platform: Quick style tweak: change "local capacity" -> "regional capacity" in the legal line, and add inline note about `X-Region` header normalization.

juan_l10n: Done in PR, updated wording and added the fallback detection line.

emma_legal: LGTM for legal. Keep it high level.

maria_docs: Great — I'm going to merge after the CI re-run. Thanks all :thumbsup:

docs-bot: CI re-run queued for https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234

maria_docs: (post-merge) merged and live in staging docs. Please shout if any wording needs tightening.

sam_platform: small follow-up — we'll add an audit log flag in the next sprint to capture region routing decisions (no doc changes needed yet).

juan_l10n: noted, will leave a TODO comment in the PR for future follow-up.

maria_docs: thanks everyone — closing the thread.
